name: Photoreal Live Action: Character Full Body
description: Image preset for a character full body in the Photoreal Live Action look.
system_prompt: Write one image prompt for a full-body design view. Describe build, default outfit, signature accessory, and stance from the entity, then apply the style. Nothing cropped.
context_prompt: full-body view of the character head to toe, standing pose that shows silhouette and costume, feet on a simple ground plane, photorealistic live-action film still, natural skin texture with pores, real fabric and material detail, true-to-life proportions, 50mm lens, motivated natural light, soft key from a window or practical lamp, neutral colour grade, gentle film grain
negative_prompt: cartoon, illustration, 3d render, plastic skin, oversaturated, extra fingers, distorted face, text, watermark
